hypothesis: The loss of headroom-normalised accel_step decodability, (R2 - control)/(1 - control), sets in gradually above e = 0.7, not as a step near 0.85. Seed-matched values (seeds 70-72, N=64, 4L, d64, 600 steps) are ~0.60 at e<=0.5, ~0.60 at e<=0.6, ~0.55-0.58 at e<=0.7 and ~0.38-0.41 at e<=0.85 (seeds 71/72). At e in [0, 0.8], the normalised margin falls between the e<=0.7 and e<=0.85 values.
expected_if_true: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, the normalised layer-4 accel_step margin at step 600 is in [0.44, 0.53], with best-of-5 control R2 between 0.28 and 0.52 and raw R2 between 0.58 and 0.78.
expected_if_false: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, the normalised margin is >= 0.54 (the drop happens late, between 0.8 and 0.85) or <= 0.43 (the drop is already complete by 0.8). Either result means the decline is not gradual across 0.7-0.85.
